annotations.title: Remove a page from a site

description: Removes one page (not the home page) from your site, using the dashboard's recoverable delete: a version is saved first and the page can be restored. Signed-in accounts only. Free.

path.description: The page to remove, e.g. "/about". The home page cannot be removed.

site_key.description: The site to remove a page from.

name: remove_page
title: Remove a page from a site
